news.headline: This former notorious red-light district is now one of the world’s top AI hubs
news.summary: King's Cross has undergone a dramatic transformation from London's notorious red-light district into a thriving AI and tech innovation hub. The neighborhood's reinvention reflects broader shifts in urban development and the growing concentration of artificial intelligence talent in global cities.

news.headline: Planned Amazon data center could become the biggest climate polluter in the U.S.
news.summary: Amazon's planned Texas data center includes an on-site power plant that could become the largest climate polluter in the U.S.—a stark reminder of AI infrastructure's environmental footprint as big tech scales compute capacity to fuel generative AI demand.

educational.title: What a Recession Actually Means (And What It Doesn't)
points: A recession is broadly defined as a significant decline in economic activity
It's not the same as a stock market crash — they can happen independently
Recessions typically bring rising unemployment and falling consumer spending
They're a normal part of economic cycles, not a rare catastrophe
Historically, markets have recovered from every recession, though timing varies
